strategies.name: tsmom
strategies.title: Time-series momentum (long/cash), risk-sized
strategies.mechanism: Trends persist because investors under-react to news and hedgers pay to offload risk (Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen 2012). Hold each asset only while its own trailing return is positive.
critic: Universe contains NVDA, chosen with hindsight (the best-performing large stock of the sample). Any edge that depends on NVDA is suspect; see ex-NVDA variants.
OOS drawdown reached -19.3%; the kill switch would have halted it on 2012-11-12.
Without NVDA the walk-forward OOS Sharpe is 0.62 (CAGR 7.7%, 73% of years beat cash) vs 0.99 with it; risk-sized buy-and-hold ex-NVDA: 0.58.

strategies.name: gsr_mr
strategies.title: Gold/silver ratio mean reversion (rotation)
strategies.mechanism: Gold and silver share a monetary driver, so the log ratio should be range-bound; when it is stretched, the cheap metal should catch up (substitution / relative value). Long-only rotation into the cheap leg because a $1,000 cash account cannot short.
critic: Best full-sample Sharpe 0.44 is not distinguishable from the best of 62 random trials (hurdle 0.55 annualised): DSR 0.33.
OOS Sharpe is only 44% of the in-sample Sharpe used to pick parameters — heavy decay, typical of overfitting.
OOS drawdown reached -10.2%; the kill switch would have halted it on 2013-06-26.

strategies.name: gold_macro
strategies.title: Gold on falling real yields (+ dollar / inflation filters)
strategies.mechanism: Gold pays no coupon, so its opportunity cost is the real interest rate; falling real yields (and a weaker dollar, the currency it is priced in) should support gold. Hold GLD only in that regime.
critic: OOS Sharpe 0.28 is below a naive risk-sized buy-and-hold of the same universe (0.36): the timing logic did not add value out of sample.
Best full-sample Sharpe 0.48 is not distinguishable from the best of 62 random trials (hurdle 0.55 annualised): DSR 0.39.
OOS Sharpe is only 38% of the in-sample Sharpe used to pick parameters — heavy decay, typical of overfitting.

strategies.name: xrotation
strategies.title: Cross-asset dual-momentum rotation with dollar/yield regime filter
strategies.mechanism: Capital rotates toward assets with improving fundamentals and flows; relative momentum picks the leaders, absolute momentum sidesteps bear markets, and a strong-dollar + rising-yield regime (tightening financial conditions) restricts the book to defensives (gold, long Treasuries). Variants with NVDA removed test whether results depend on one hindsight-selected winner.
critic: OOS Sharpe 0.64 is below a naive risk-sized buy-and-hold of the same universe (0.85): the timing logic did not add value out of sample.
Universe contains NVDA, chosen with hindsight (the best-performing large stock of the sample). Any edge that depends on NVDA is suspect; see ex-NVDA variants.
OOS Sharpe is only 44% of the in-sample Sharpe used to pick parameters — heavy decay, typical of overfitting.
Without NVDA the walk-forward OOS Sharpe is 0.32 (CAGR 3.5%, 60% of years beat cash) vs 0.64 with it; risk-sized buy-and-hold ex-NVDA: 0.58.
